[SPELL — Earth Lance] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Earth · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Summons an earthen spike from the ground. A flat-top version can lift the caster like an elevator or serve as a lookout tower.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Earth Lance [Earth Magic - Intermediate]: A fast, highly penetrative spell that forms a spear of compressed stone. While less destructive than Stone Cannon, its aerodynamic shape allows it to fly faster and pierce through standard magical barriers. Often used by royal guards to impale charging beasts.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Nuclear Cannon [Earth Magic - Divine]: A tactical-scale magic spell that fires a massive, hyper-compressed sphere of earth and rock. It possesses enough kinetic energy to vaporize large fortresses upon impact. Requires a near-infinite mana reserve; typically reserved for fighting Demon Lords or True Dragons.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Gravity Prison [Earth Magic - Imperial]: A high-tier spell that creates a localized, crushing gravitational field. Targets within the radius find their weight increased a hundredfold, forcing them to the ground and effectively pinning them under the weight of the air itself.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] Not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Mud Wall [Melded Magic - Intermediate]: Combines Earth and Water magic to create a thick, highly viscous barrier of mud. It excels at absorbing kinetic energy, stopping cannonballs, arrows, and physical sword strikes without shattering like a rigid stone wall would.

[SPELL — Gravity Magic] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Unique (Future Rudeus, Kalman III) · Rank: —
Effect: Manipulates gravity, allowing flight or levitating objects.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Gravity Magic: An ancient, nearly lost branch of magic originally utilized by the Dragon Race and currently wielded only by a select few (such as Alexander Rybak via the Kajakut sword). Allows the user to manipulate local gravitational fields to crush opponents, fly, or attract physical objects. Extremely mana-intensive.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Megalithic Crash [Earth Magic - King]: Summons a meteor-sized chunk of hyper-dense bedrock directly above the battlefield. It is dropped utilizing artificial gravity acceleration, creating a seismic shockwave that can flatten castles and turn entire platoons of heavily armored knights to paste.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Tidal Wave [Water Magic - King]: Conjures an ocean-scale wall of water that crashes down on the battlefield. It is not just water; the current is infused with mana to act like a solid wall of iron, crushing everything it touches.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Water Waterfall [Water Magic - Advanced]: Summons a massive, pressurized cascade of water from a localized dimensional rift above the target. Used primarily to extinguish large-scale fire magic, wash away toxic gases, or pin agile enemies to the ground under tons of hydrostatic pressure.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Earth Spear [Earth Magic - Intermediate]: A spell that manipulates the ground beneath an opponent to violently erupt upward in the shape of a massive, jagged stalagmite. Extremely effective for impaling charging monsters or disrupting cavalry formations. Rudeus frequently uses this to alter battlefield terrain.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Absolute Freeze [Water Magic - Imperial]: A spell that halts all molecular movement within a designated area. Targets don't just get cold; they lose the ability to move, cast spells, or even think, as their internal energy is stolen by the spell's effect.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] Not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Void Pulse [Void Magic - Saint]: A low-mana-cost utility spell. It emits a 5-meter wave of absolute nullification. It doesn't destroy objects, but it temporarily 'turns off' the magicule conductivity of any item or construct it touches, rendering magical barriers useless for 3 seconds.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Inferno Blast [Fire Magic - King]: A massive, omnidirectional eruption of fire that turns the battlefield into a literal sea of magma. Used to incinerate entire armies. The intense heat warps the air, creating a refractive barrier that makes the caster nearly impossible to target with ranged spells.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Wind Razor [Wind Magic - Intermediate]: Compresses air into a crescent-shaped blade that flies at high speed. It is invisible to the naked eye and highly effective at severing limbs or decapitating unarmored foes. Its silence makes it a favorite among magical assassins.

[SPELL — Ice Pillar] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Creates a shaft of ice springing up from the ground.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Ice Pillar [Water Magic - Intermediate]: Flash-freezes ambient moisture into a durable column of ice. Used dynamically by Roxy and Rudeus as stepping stones to gain aerial advantage, or as immediate barricades to block narrow corridors within labyrinths.

[SPELL — Flamethrower] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Fire · Rank: not stated
Effect: Attacks with a jet of flames over a wide area.
Chant: "May this small, smoldering fire call forth a great and searing blessing! Flamethrower!"
(The wiki gives no rank; judge it by the effect's scale using the MAGIC TIERS.)

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Flamethrower [Fire Magic - Intermediate]: Projects a continuous, cone-shaped stream of fire. Instead of a singular explosion, the caster sustains the mana output, sweeping the area. Highly effective against swarms of low-level monsters like Acid Wolves or giant insects.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] Not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Chrono-Static [Time Magic - Advanced]: Freezes a single inanimate object in time. It becomes indestructible and immovable for the duration of the spell. Used by mages to create temporary cover during intense firefights or to preserve decaying ingredients.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Healing Aura [Healing Magic - Saint]: Projects a sustained field of restorative energy. Rather than instantly closing a wound, it drastically accelerates the natural cellular regeneration of anyone standing inside it. Highly mana-intensive but essential for keeping an entire frontline squad alive against continuous damage.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Calamity Flame [Fire Magic - Imperial]: Conjures a sentient, predatory pillar of flame that tracks moving heat signatures. Once it latches onto a target, it continues to burn until there is nothing left to consume, including magic energy.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Air Cushion [Wind Magic - Beginner]: A utility spell that rapidly condenses a pocket of air directly beneath the caster. Used to completely negate falling damage from extreme heights. Sylphiette mastered this to allow Ariel's bodyguards to jump from castle walls during their escape from Asura.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Melting Point [Fire Magic - King]: Focuses an extreme amount of thermal energy into a singular, microscopic point. It bypasses the concept of 'burning' and instantly causes matter to undergo atomic sublimation. Capable of melting through Manatite scales or Saint-tier Touki.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Cyclone of Ruin [Wind Magic - Imperial]: A massive, stationary tornado that acts as a magical blender. It shreds anything that comes within 50 meters into microscopic pieces. Often used to guard retreat paths or protect casters from swarming low-tier monsters.

Stellar Beam [Light Magic - Imperial]: Channels raw photonic energy from the sun into a concentrated, high-frequency lance of light. It bypasses physical durability by heating molecules until they become plasma. Effective against regenerating monsters like Hydras or Undead.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] Not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Spatial Fragmentation [Space Magic - Imperial]: Rips the local geometry of an area into jagged, non-Euclidean shards. Targets inside the area are cut from multiple angles simultaneously by the space itself. Highly effective at bypassing thick plate armor.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Wind God's Breath [Wind Magic - Divine]: A focused, hyper-pressurized beam of wind that can slice through mountains. The wind is compressed so tightly it acts like a laser, capable of cutting through divine barriers with ease.

[SPELL — Tornado] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Wind · Rank: Saint
Effect: Creates a tornado that can alter the weather by moving clouds and can cancel a Blizzard Storm; magic teachers advise against altering the weather.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Tornado [Wind Magic - Advanced]: Summons a violent, localized cyclone. It strips enemies of their footing, deflects projectile attacks, and hurls debris at lethal speeds. Sylphiette uses miniature versions of this to launch herself across the battlefield with extreme agility.

Summon: Guardian Beast [Summoning Magic - Advanced]: A complex summoning circle that pulls a mid-to-high-tier monster (like a Dire Wolf or Armored Bear) from its habitat and forces a temporary subjugation contract. If the caster lacks sufficient mana, the beast will immediately turn and devour them instead.

[SPELL — Quagmire] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Melded (Water + Earth) · Rank: Melded
Effect: Turns the ground into a muddy swamp that immobilizes the enemy. Rudeus used it so much he became known as "Quagmire".

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Quagmire (Spell): A fusion of Earth and Water magic that turns solid ground into a deep, sticky, viscous bog. Rudeus's signature crowd-control spell. It strips enemies of their footing, making charging swordsmen and monsters helpless. He became so famous for this spell that he was globally branded as 'Rudeus of the Quagmire'.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Vacuum Wave [Wind Magic - Saint]: Slices the atmosphere itself to create a blade of pure vacuum. Because it removes the air in its path, it causes explosive decompression inside the bodies of targets it hits. It is completely invisible and ignores physical armor.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Healing Rain [Divine Magic - Saint]: Projects a massive area-effect downpour of holy droplets. Anyone standing in the rain is constantly healed of non-lethal wounds and has poison neutralized. Used during large-scale sieges to keep frontline troops at peak fighting capacity.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Purify [Divine Magic - Beginner]: A foundational spell of the Millis Church. Emits a soft, holy light that cleanses minor curses, purges tainted food or water, and mildly repels low-level necrotic beings. Heavily relied upon by traveling clerics.

[SPELL — Exodus Flame] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Fire · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Gathers a large wave of flame and releases it; it explodes on impact. The heat can burn the caster while channeling at close range.
Chant: "Raging spirit of flame, bastard of hell! Rise to the land of man and swing your fist! Strike down my sworn foe and consume them within darkness! Exodus Flame!"

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Exodus Flame: An Advanced-tier Fire spell. Generates a highly concentrated, hyper-pressurized jet of blue-white flame that cuts through armor and vaporizes flesh. Cannot be extinguished by normal water and burns until the target is reduced to ash.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it. CARD LAW OVERRIDES IT: no healing regrows a lost limb or eye, and nothing brings back the dead. If used at all, it can only do what the law allows (stabilize, slow death, ease pain) and the description below is a legend that overstates it.
Resurrection Ritual [Divine Magic - Divine]: A high-cost ritual requiring massive amounts of gold and precious jewels. It channels holy energy to pull a soul back from the afterlife into an intact body. It is notoriously fickle—if the soul refuses, or if the god of the afterlife (Millis) denies it, the spell fails.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Advanced Detoxification [Healing Magic - Advanced]: Required to cure complex, multi-layered neurotoxins or magical venoms found in A-Rank monsters. The caster must perfectly visualize the chemical breakdown of the poison in the bloodstream, requiring extreme medical knowledge.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it. CARD LAW OVERRIDES IT: no healing regrows a lost limb or eye, and nothing brings back the dead. If used at all, it can only do what the law allows (stabilize, slow death, ease pain) and the description below is a legend that overstates it.
Regeneration Magic [Healing Magic - King]: The absolute apex of biological restoration. Capable of forcing cells to divide at impossible speeds to rebuild a severed limb from a bloody stump. Drains an astronomical amount of mana and requires the target to consume massive calories afterward to survive the metabolic shock.

[SPELL — Teleportation Magic] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Unique (Orsted, Rudeus Greyrat, Perugius Dola and others) · Rank: —
Effect: Travel to corresponding sites almost instantly through magic circles. Three types: bi-directional, single-directional, and random teleportation circles. Teleportation magic is forbidden; the Dragon Tribe hides old circle ruins behind Illusion Barriers.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Teleportation Magic: Globally banned. After the Teleportation Labyrinth and historical incidents where teleportation circles were used to bypass kingdom defenses and assassinate kings, the global Magic Guild made researching or using teleportation magic punishable by death.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Anti-Magic Barrier [Divine Magic - Advanced]: Projects a hexagonal, glowing shield that actively destabilizes incoming magical formulas. While physical objects can pass through it with some resistance, offensive spells striking the barrier dissolve back into ambient magicules.

[SPELL — Frost Nova] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Melded (Water Splash + Icicle Field) · Rank: Melded
Effect: Soaks enemies with water droplets and freezes them; with more mana they freeze to the core.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Frost Nova [Water Magic - Advanced]: A highly localized, explosive burst of absolute cold. Instead of firing a projectile, the caster violently drops the ambient temperature in a 10-meter radius around them, flash-freezing the moisture in the air and immobilizing surrounding enemies in blocks of jagged ice.

[SPELL — Heat Island] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Fire · Rank: not stated
Effect: Heats the surrounding environment.
(The wiki gives no rank; judge it by the effect's scale using the MAGIC TIERS.)

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Heat Island [Fire Magic - Saint]: Instead of a direct explosion, this spell boils the earth and superheats the terrain across a massive battlefield. Water evaporates instantly, the ground turns to scalding slag, and enemies die of extreme heatstroke and dehydration within minutes.

[SPELL — Sandstorm] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Earth · Rank: Saint
Effect: Conjures a fierce torrent of sand and wind over a wide area, or stops an existing sandstorm.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Sandstorm [Earth/Wind Magic - Advanced]: A composite spell utilizing both earth and wind magic. Summons a violent, blinding vortex of abrasive sand that strips the flesh from bone and reduces visibility to zero. Frequently used by mercenaries on the Begaritt Continent to escape ambushes.

[SPELL — Rock Bullet] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Earth · Rank: Elementary
Effect: Materializes a bullet-sized rock to hit a target.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Rock Bullet [Earth Magic - Intermediate]: The standard, un-modified version of Stone Cannon. Fires a simple, fist-sized chunk of rock at high velocity. Without Rudeus's Voiceless super-compression and spin, it acts like a heavy musket ball—lethal to humans, but easily deflected by Saint-tier Touki.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it. CARD LAW OVERRIDES IT: no healing regrows a lost limb or eye, and nothing brings back the dead. If used at all, it can only do what the law allows (stabilize, slow death, ease pain) and the description below is a legend that overstates it.
Ex-Heal [Healing Magic - King]: The absolute pinnacle of cellular regeneration. Restores missing organs, re-grows entirely severed limbs from nothing, and can revive a person who has been clinically dead for less than a few minutes. Requires massive mana and an agonizingly long, complex chant.

[FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON] This spell is not in the novels or the wiki. Treat it as extremely rare or legendary: known to few, never taught at schools, and never assumed to exist unless the story establishes it.
Shining Heal [Healing Magic - Saint]: An area-of-effect healing spell. Projects a massive dome of golden light. Every ally standing within the light has their wounds rapidly closed, stamina restored, and minor poisons purged. The primary spell used by Zenith Greyrat during large-scale party combat.

Telepathy [Racial Magic - Migurd]: The innate ability of the Migurd demon race. Allows for instantaneous, silent, and highly nuanced mental communication across vast distances. Roxy Migurdia is a mutant born entirely without this ability, leading to her intense isolation and eventual departure from her village.

[SPELL — Absolute Zero] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: Imperial
Effect: Freezes a very wide area instantly.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Absolute Zero [Water Magic - Imperial]: A catastrophic area-of-effect spell. It instantaneously drops the temperature of a massive radius to absolute zero. Organic matter, steel, and even magic spells freeze and crystallize instantly. The caster can then trigger a physical shockwave to shatter the frozen targets into dust.

[SPELL — Earth Fortress] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Earth · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Creates a fortress of earth around the user. It needs mana to stay up or it crumbles; Rudeus's igloo-shaped version holds itself together with no mana after casting.
Chant: Truncated: "Envelop me in the earth's magnificent armor. Earth Fortress!"

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Earth Fortress [Earth Magic - Advanced]: Pulls up a massive, multi-layered defensive bunker of hardened earth from the ground. Can be shaped into a dome to completely encapsulate the caster or allies. Excellent for defending against wide-area physical attacks, but vulnerable to concussive force shattering the interior.

[SPELL — Stone Cannon] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Earth · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Launches a bullet-shaped rock at high speed. Rudeus's signature spell: with hardness, spin and speed at maximum it pierces even Orsted's and Badigadi's Battle Aura.
Chant: "Answer my call, God of Obscurities, and shatter my enemy! Stone Cannon!"

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Stone Cannon [Earth Magic - Intermediate]: The signature spell of Rudeus. Ordinarily, it creates a simple rock projectile. However, utilizing Voiceless Casting, the user can spin the projectile at drill-like speeds, super-compress the earth density, and accelerate it to supersonic velocities. In this form, it gains the destructive force of an anti-tank railgun, capable of ripping through Demon Kings and Touki-infused flesh.

[SPELL — Cumulonimbus] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: Saint
Effect: Creates a thundercloud and pours torrential rain over a large area, with occasional lightning strikes.
Chant: "Grand spirit of water and imperial prince of lightning who ascends the heavens, grant my wish and bring about a savage blessing. Display your might to insignificant beings. Strike awe with a blow of your divine hammer on the anvil, and cover the land in water! Ah, Rain! Sweep all else away and expel everything! Cumulonimbus!"

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Cumulonimbus [Water Magic - Saint]: Summons a massive, unnatural storm cloud over a wide geographical area. For the next hour, it unleashes torrential freezing rain, hurricane-force winds, and indiscriminate lightning strikes. Used by Roxy to pass her graduation exam. Can be weaponized to rapidly flood terrain, turning battlefields into inescapable bogs.

[SPELL — Lightning] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: King
Effect: Creates a thundercloud as per Cumulonimbus and condenses all its energy into a powerful lightning bolt on the designated target.
Chant: Long chant: the Cumulonimbus chant followed by an invocation of the spirit of light ("...Let your radiant power teach him that the Emperor yet reign supreme! Lightning!").

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Lightning [Water Magic - King]: An execution-tier spell. Compresses the atmospheric moisture and energy of a storm cloud into a single, blindingly fast bolt of directional electricity. Capable of instantly carbonizing a target. Because it moves at the speed of actual lightning, it is nearly impossible to dodge even with advanced Touki.

[SPELL — Disturb Magic] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Unique (Orsted, Rudeus Greyrat, Sylphiette) · Rank: —
Effect: Cancels an opponent's magic by disrupting it so it never takes shape and scatters. It targets only one part of the body: in Orsted's first fight with Rudeus it sealed the magic in Rudeus's right hand, but he could still cast with his left. Rudeus and Sylphiette train it together, one holding a spell while the other tries to break it.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Disturb Magic [Unique]: An advanced anti-magic technique created by Orsted. The caster injects a small, precise pulse of their own mana into the opponent's spell just as it is forming, instantly destabilizing the magical formula. Causes the enemy's spell to fizzle out or explode in their face. It makes the user virtually immune to traditional mages, though it has no effect on physical Touki attacks.

Flashover [Fire Magic - Saint]: A terrifying area-of-effect spell. It superheats the ambient air in a large radius and ignites it all simultaneously. Creates a localized firestorm that rapidly consumes all oxygen, creating a vacuum that suffocates anyone who isn't immediately incinerated.

[SPELL — Exodus Flame] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Fire · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Gathers a large wave of flame and releases it; it explodes on impact. The heat can burn the caster while channeling at close range.
Chant: "Raging spirit of flame, bastard of hell! Rise to the land of man and swing your fist! Strike down my sworn foe and consume them within darkness! Exodus Flame!"

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Exodus Flame [Fire Magic - Advanced]: A highly concentrated jet or sphere of blue-white fire. Burns significantly hotter than normal fire magic, capable of melting steel and vaporizing flesh instantly. Cannot be easily extinguished by normal water.

[SPELL — Sonic Boom] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Wind · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Launches a slicing wind blade forward and throws the target away.

Extra notes (older lorebook text; the wiki block above wins if they disagree):
Sonic Boom [Wind Magic - Intermediate]: Releases a concentrated shockwave of compressed air. Used less for lethal damage and more for intense concussive knockback. Excellent for disorienting charging swordsmen or deflecting incoming projectiles. Sylphiette uses wind magic to cushion falls and increase her movement speed.

[SPELL — Illusion Barrier] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Barrier · Rank: unknown
Effect: Used by the Dragon Tribe to hide teleportation circle ruins behind an illusion of scenery, maintained by a monument (e.g. Saint Dragon General Szilard's emblem in Lumen Forest near Sharia). Released by pouring mana into the tablet and reciting a release chant known only to the Dragon Tribe and Nanahoshi; teleportation magic is forbidden.
Chant: Release chant invokes Saint Dragon Emperor Szilard ("...In the name of Saint Dragon Emperor Szilard, I hereby break this seal.")

[SPELL — Water Shield] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: Elementary
Effect: Creates a spout of water from the ground forming a defensive wall. With enough mana, a huge wall of water can even protect the caster from a Red Dragon's or the Manatite Hydra's fire breath.

[SPELL — Flame Slice] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Fire · Rank: not stated
Effect: Shoots a blade of flame that sears and slices the enemy.
Chant: Truncated: "Take up thy burnt blade and pierce through thy enemy! Flame Slice!"
(The wiki gives no rank; judge it by the effect's scale using the MAGIC TIERS.)

[SPELL — Flame Pillar] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Fire · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Materializes a pillar of fire.

[SPELL — Water Cannon] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Launches a large concentration of water. (Called Splash Flow in the anime.)
Chant: "Supple spirit of water and princess of streams that flow through the earth, sweep away all things with your hidden inner might."

[SPELL — Earth Hedgehog] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Earth · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Summons many earthen spikes from the ground to impale enemies; can also be launched as a small sphere that spikes the target area.

[SPELL — Otherworld Summon] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Summoning (Nanahoshi) · Rank: —
Effect: Summons an object or organism from another world (Earth). Needs a highly complex multi-layered magic circle; the more complex the target, the larger the circle.

[SPELL — Shine Healing] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Healing · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Heals major open wounds and reattaches FRESHLY severed limbs, but cannot restore lost body parts.

[SPELL — Magic Shield] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Barrier · Rank: Elementary
Effect: A semi-transparent barrier that blocks magical attacks and can isolate flames or cold to reduce their effect.

[SPELL — Blizzard Storm] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Shoots ice shards in all directions.
Chant: Truncated: "King of Frost, supreme ruler of the arctic lands, sovereign wrapped in all white whose frigid cold robs all heat. Freeze thy enemy, oh glacial king who governs death! Blizzard Storm!"

[SPELL — Wind Blast] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Wind · Rank: not stated
Effect: Releases a gust of strong wind (Rudeus uses it to dodge an attack).
(The wiki gives no rank; judge it by the effect's scale using the MAGIC TIERS.)

[SPELL — Monster Summon] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Summoning (Orsted, Perugius, Rudeus) · Rank: —
Effect: Summons an existing creature through magic circles. A founding covenant forbids summoning intelligent humanoid races. Conditions can be set; summoning something with more mana than the summoner is hard and risks losing control (Rudeus summoned Leo).

[SPELL — Icicle Edge] (Mushoku Tensei Wiki, Magic Spells)
School: Water · Rank: not stated
Effect: Launches a crescent-shaped ice blade at the enemy (Roxy cut through an Armored Warrior with it).
